I POSTED THIS OVER 2 WEEKS AGO AND THEY REMOVED IT SO I AM REPOSTING. I HAVE POSTED PHOTOS OF THEIR LIASISON BRITTANY SEVILLA WHO LIED TO ME IN THE EMAIL AND CLAIMED IT WAS DUE TO THE HOLIDAY. IT WAS PURCHASED ON A TUESDAY WHICH WAS 6 DAYS BEFORE THE HOLIDAY AND THEIR WEBSITE SAYS NEXT DAY SHIPPING.

Management - I wanted to give you a 2 star rating if not for the rude employee who hung up on me around 3pm when I called today on 9/2.

On Centinelas website, it clearly says that all orders placed after 2:30pm will ship out the next day VIA GROUND 1-3 delivery days. Keep in mind my order was placed on 8/26 at 2:45pm and today is 9/2. In that span of time, I have left 2 voicemails on the customer service number listed online + sent 2 follow up emails to which I hear back from no one. I guess spending $104 is not enough for good customer service or customer service of any kind.

I called the Wilshire Blvd location just now since that is where it said the order was shipping from given that the delivery address was in 90404 and they are located at 90403. A very nice lady transferred me VIA call to this address since she said it actually shipped from the 90066 store.

I sat on hold for a few minutes and once the call was picked up, the employee immediately disconnected the call, kinda rude, no? So I called back the Wilshire store and let her know what happened to which she replied "of course they hung up on you, not surprised" so I guess this is the norm for this store now? I worked here a little over 5 years ago and this would have never happened under Allan's & Phalan's management as they truly cared about the customers experience.

The Wilshire store employee gave me the 90066 stores phone number and I called back. The lady who answers, who I am assuming is the same lady who hung up on me (this is around 3pm on 9/2), sounds both frustrated and inconvenienced to have to take my call. Which is odd given that the status of the store shows as NOT BUSY at this time of day. Hopefully she is receiving the support from her coworkers that she obviously needs.

After sitting on hold for another 5 to 7 minutes, I finally get to speak to the general manager Kiki. She was very pleasant and confirmed that her team dropped the ball because they "forgot" about Mondays holiday and the team decided to not call me and tell me that they did not have enough wet food and were 2 cans short. Keep in mind I have now been out of my cats food for almost a week because it was confirmed as IN STOCK for the store.

Management - Please retrain the staff on the importance of customer service and communication. I should have been called the moment they realized they did not have enough cans so that they could have advised me that I would be receiving my order later than promised.

I am very happy Kiki offered a 20% discount for my next order (you rock Kiki and I greatly appreciate you) but this should not have been a 20 minute ordeal and your employee should not be hanging up on people top avoid calls, that is call avoidance and would not be tolerated by Allan during my time there.

Lastly, I finally received an email response and was told all this happened due to a "holiday delay" which is a cute cover up. Too bad I already found out that the team chose not to inform me that they were short by 2 cans and needed to wait for their next delivery of Farmina.
